draft.subject_line: Coalesce Catalog and the controls cadence
draft.body:
Catalog metadata is the source of truth for which assets carry which policy. The IAM, Snowflake roles, and cloud-config that actually enforce those policies sit one layer down — and the gap between policy-in-catalog and control-in-cloud is invisible until a control turns out not to have been doing what the catalog implied.

Worth fifteen minutes if how that gap is closed today is something you've been working through?
draft.architecture: signal-to-question — observation about where catalog metadata lives vs where enforcement lives, the named failure mode, the question. No product feature list.

verdict_history.reason: Middle paragraph was four-item feature inventory + unverifiable compatibility claim — read as vendor brochure regardless of brevity around it.

Stripping the brochure revealed the underlying observation was generic — 'controls need to stay verified at the same cadence policies change' is a category-truism. 'Catalog' was a mail-merge variable.

Anchored the observation in specific enforcement primitives (IAM, Snowflake roles, cloud-config) and a concrete failure mode (control not doing what catalog implied). A hands-in-the-code engineering leader building this product recognizes this as grounded, not projected.

witness.what_works: Three sentences. Names the specific architectural seam between policy-declaration (catalog metadata) and policy-enforcement (cloud primitives). Concrete failure mode. CTA invites him to share his current approach if he has one.
witness.what_fails: Subject line 'Coalesce Catalog and the controls cadence' carries leftover v2 'cadence' framing while the body moved to a gap framing. Witness flagged this as a residual seam not worth another rewrite cycle. Acceptable risk.

review_flags: subject-body-mild-asymmetry: subject names 'cadence' but body names 'gap' — minor seam noted by witness, not fatal, not worth blocking ship
coordinate-across-coalesce-leads: four contacts at one 142-person org. Sequence the four sends across at least 6 weeks; do not blast the company
